subject: Post-discovery: lock TDX date, attendee roster, and focus areas
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@averysys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: lock TDX date, attendee roster, and focus areas

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps so we can get the technical deep dive (60–90m) on the calendar with the right folks from both sides.

Recap (what we heard):
- Primary use case: low-latency inference for multi-tenant web service, heavy tail of short completions (~50 tokens).
- Success metrics: P95 latency < 150ms, cost target <$0.002/token, and auditability for data retention.
- Risk areas: SSO/KMS integration, data residency questions, and request-level observability.

Proposed TDX scope: architecture walk (20–30m), model serving/quantization options (20m), ops/runbook and scaling (20m), Q&A + next-phase plan (10–20m).

Time options (all PT):
- Option A: Thu Jul 13, 10:00–11:30
- Option B: Mon Jul 17, 14:00–15:30
- Option C: Tue Jul 18, 09:00–10:30

Can you confirm preferred slot and who from Avery should attend (names + roles)? On our side I'll bring Marissa (ML infra lead) and Ben (solutions engineer) — Marissa will cover the runtime/quantization recommendations; Ben will run the ops/runbook portion.

Pre-reads and asks:
- Attached: TDX_Pre-read_v1.pdf (short checklist + environment questions)
- Please share: list of attendees, any blocked IP ranges, and whether you prefer SSO demo vs. SAML configuration walkthrough.

If none of the proposed windows work, paste a couple alternatives and we’ll accommodate. I’ll hold Option A tentatively until I hear back.

Thanks — Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198

[Attachment: TDX_Pre-read_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@averysys.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@averysys.com
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: lock TDX date, attendee roster, and focus areas

Thanks, Stephanie — great summary. Option A (Thu Jul 13, 10:00–11:30 PT) works best for us. Attendees from our side:
- Sarah Jones — Head of Product (will lead)
- Miguel Alvarez — ML Platform Engineer (deep dive on deployment)
- Priya Desai — Security (SSO/KMS questions)
- Procurement (procurement@averysys.com) — for logistics (they may join for first 15m)

A couple quick asks:
- Can Marissa include a slide on quantization tradeoffs and recommended model variants for latency vs cost?
- We'd like the SSO demo to show both SAML and OIDC flows if possible.

I'll upload the attendee roster to the folder you linked and confirm procurement's availability separately. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

— Sarah
Sarah Jones | Head of Product, Avery Systems
sarah.jones@averysys.com | +1 206-555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@averysys.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jul 2028 13:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: lock TDX date, attendee roster, and focus areas

Hi all — adding a couple operational / prep notes from the ML infra side. I’ll take the quantization + model-variant section, and Ben will run the autoscaling/runbook examples. Proposed agenda (refined):
1) Brief recap of goals (5m)
2) Architecture & deployment options (20m) — Marissa
   - multi-tenant routing, model pinning, and regional routing
3) Performance levers (20m) — quantization, batching, KV cache behavior
4) Ops/runbook + autoscale demos (20m) — Ben
5) Security & compliance checklist (10m) — Priya from Avery to lead this segment
6) Open Q&A and next steps (15m)

Prep items for Avery (from attachment + new asks):
- Example peak + baseline request rates (rps) and typical sequence length distribution
- Any compliance constraints (retention/region) we should bake into the demo
- SSO endpoints and a test account if you want a live SAML/OIDC demo (otherwise we can demo with screenshots)

Attachment: Redwood_Attendee_Roles.xlsx — a one-pager showing who on our side will present which sections. Also linking a HubSpot meeting placeholder: https://hubspot.com/deal/AVY-2028-047 — please accept the meeting invite when it appears.

Marissa Cole
Senior ML Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

[Attachment: Redwood_Attendee_Roles.xlsx (xlsx)]

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Sarah. I’ve locked Thu Jul 13, 10:00–11:30 PT and sent a calendar invite to all participants (please check your inbox / spam). Calendar invite includes: agenda, pre-read (TDX_Pre-read_v1.pdf), and the Drive folder link.

- Meeting will use our Zoom link (included in invite). If procurement needs a separate invite or PO number in the invite body, reply here and we’ll update.

- Sarah — if you can drop Miguel's test account SAML endpoint into the Drive folder before EOD today, Marissa can set up the live demo; otherwise we’ll do screenshots for the SSO flow.

Thanks — excited to run through this.

Steph
